review.note: Merged in M44b into carnation-revolution-1974, the same event. The atlas has held 25 April since M2 under a Portuguese title and with no Wikidata item, so neither the item test nor the label test of M44a’s tick rule reached it — the blind spot deviation 670 caught for the proclamation of the Republic, a batch too late here. This record keeps Q193245 and the two Wikipedia links, and names its survivor rather than becoming an anonymous tombstone. The full account is in docs/m44-retractions.md.
